title: Cash-Back and Rewards Harvest
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cashback:reward
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount) as earned by _time program
| stats sum(earned) as total by program
| sort - total
description: Totals the cash-back and rewards you actually earned by program, so you use the cards and schemes that pay.
value: Rewards only matter if collected; a per-program total shows which schemes are worth the effort and which to drop.
implementation: Ingest rewards feeds into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and total earnings per program.
visualization: Bar chart of rewards earned by program.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the cash-back and points you actually earn, so you know which reward schemes are worth using.
